nomen.name: Delaunay 3D
nomen.info: Compute the Delaunay tetrahedralisation for a set of points in 3d space.

inputs.name: Quality Threshold
inputs.info: Minimum quality threshold for tetrahedra ranging from 0 to 1. Tetrahedra with quality below this value will be removed from the output.

outputs.name: Edge Indices
outputs.info: Indices of the edge ends in the input point list.

outputs.name: Vertex Neighbours
outputs.info: Indices of the neighbouring vertices for each vertex in the input point list.

outputs.name: Tetrahedron Vertex Indices
outputs.info: Indices of the vertices of each tetrahedron in the input point list.

outputs.name: Tetrahedron Neighbours
outputs.info: For each tetrahedron, the indices of the four neighbouring tetrahedra, or -1 if it is a boundary face.

nomen.name: Lake Shores
nomen.info: Find the shorelines of all lakes implied by a topographical mesh.

nomen.name: Tetrahedron
nomen.info: Create a mesh tetrahedron from four vertex points.

nomen.name: Voronoi 3D
nomen.info: Compute the volumetric Voronoi diagram for a set of points.

inputs.name: Points
inputs.info: Cell seed points for the volumetric Voronoi diagram.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.info: Optional bounding box. If omitted, a bounding box is computed from the input points.

nomen.name: Mesh From Box
nomen.info: Create a box-shaped mesh with a specific number of facets in each direction.

inputs.name: X Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets in the box x direction.

inputs.name: Y Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets in the box y direction.

inputs.name: Z Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets in the box z direction.

nomen.name: Circular Cap
nomen.info: Create a quad-only circular cap based on a specific topological schema.

nomen.name: Mesh From Disc
nomen.info: Create a mesh with radially oriented facets covering a circular disc.

inputs.name: Quad Facets
inputs.info: Specifies whether the mesh is made out of quadrilaterals instead of triangles.

nomen.name: Mesh From Sphere (Ico)
nomen.info: Create a spherical mesh based on an icosahedral subdivision.

inputs.name: Division Count
inputs.info: Number of mesh edges per icosahedral edge.

nomen.name: Mesh From Sphere (Quad)
nomen.info: Create a spherical mesh based on a quadrilateral subdivision.

inputs.name: Division Count
inputs.info: Number of mesh edges per quad edge.

nomen.name: Mesh From Rectangle
nomen.info: Create a rectangular mesh with a specific number of rows and columns.

inputs.name: X Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets in the x direction.

inputs.name: Y Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets in the y direction.

nomen.name: Mesh From Facet Count
nomen.info: Create a rectangular mesh with an approximate number of squarish facets. This component tries to balance the oftentimes opposing goals of creating a mesh with a specific number of facets and creating a mesh with square facets.

outputs.name: Facet Count
outputs.info: Actual facet count used in mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh From Sphere
nomen.info: Create a spherical mesh with a specific number of facets in the longitude and latitude directions.

inputs.name: Longitude Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets around the sphere.

inputs.name: Latitude Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets between the sphere poles.

nomen.name: Mesh Torus
nomen.info: Create a toroidal mesh.

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.info: Radius of torus at each slice.

inputs.name: Along Divisions
inputs.info: Number of mesh facets along the central rail.

inputs.name: Around Divisions
inputs.info: Number of mesh facets around the central rail.

inputs.name: Around Offset
inputs.info: Rotational offset of facets at the torus seam.

nomen.name: Mesh From Triangle
nomen.info: Create a  triangular mesh with a custom density.

inputs.name: Divisions
inputs.info: Number of mesh edges per triangle edge

nomen.name: Mesh From Tube
nomen.info: Create a tube-shaped mesh with a specific number of facets.

inputs.name: Around Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets around the tube.

inputs.name: Vertical Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets along the sides of the tube.

inputs.name: Cap Facets
inputs.info: Number of facets on the caps of the tube.

nomen.name: Graph From L-System
nomen.info: Create a graph out of an L-System string.

inputs.name: L-System
inputs.info: L-System string containing instructions: L(ine), M(ove), +(turn left), -(turn right), etc.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Angle of L-System turns in degrees.

nomen.name: Edge Facets
nomen.info: Find all the facet indices relying on a given edge.

inputs.name: Edge Index
inputs.info: Index of the edge under examination.

outputs.name: Facet Vertices
outputs.info: Indices of all facets relying on the given edge.

nomen.name: Edge Neighbours
nomen.info: Find all edge indices emanating from the end points of a given edge.

outputs.name: Start Edges
outputs.info: Indices of all edges emanating from the start of the given edge.

outputs.name: End Edges
outputs.info: Indices of all edges emanating from the end of the given edge.

nomen.name: Edge Vertices
nomen.info: Find all the vertex indices at either end of a given mesh edge.

outputs.name: Start Vertices
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices at the start of the given edge.

outputs.name: End Vertices
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices at the end of the given edge.

nomen.name: Indices From Facet
nomen.info: Extract the vertex indices located at the corners of a mesh facet.

inputs.name: Facet
inputs.info: Mesh facet to extract indices from.

outputs.name: Fourth Index
outputs.info: Vertex index at fourth corner. If the facet is a triangle, the fourth index will be equal to the third index.

nomen.name: Facet From Indices
nomen.info: Create a mesh facet out of three or four corner indices.

inputs.name: Fourth Index
inputs.info: Optional vertex index at fourth corner.

nomen.name: Mesh Counts
nomen.info: Count the number of elements that make up a mesh shape.

outputs.name: Vertex Count
outputs.info: Number of vertices in the mesh.

outputs.name: Facet Count
outputs.info: Number of facets in the mesh.

outputs.name: Edge Count
outputs.info: Number of edges in the mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh Edge
nomen.info: Extract the line and implied normal direction of a specific mesh edge.

inputs.name: Mesh
inputs.info: Mesh to extract an edge line and normal from.

outputs.name: Edge Normal
outputs.info: Normal direction for the edge, as implied by adjacent vertex and facet normals.

nomen.name: Edge Categories
nomen.info: Group the edges of a mesh into various mutually exclusive categories.

outputs.name: Welded Edges
outputs.info: Edges with two adjacent facets and no stacked vertices.

outputs.name: Welded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of edges with two adjacent facets and no stacked vertices.

outputs.name: Unwelded Edges
outputs.info: Edges with two adjacent facets and stacked vertices on one or both ends.

outputs.name: Unwelded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of edges with two adjacent facets and stacked vertices at one or both ends.

outputs.name: Naked Edges
outputs.info: Edges with only a single adjacent facet.

outputs.name: Naked Indices
outputs.info: Indices of edges with only a single adjacent facet.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Edges
outputs.info: Edges with three or more adjacent facets.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Indices
outputs.info: Indices of edges with three or more adjacent facets.

nomen.name: Edge Categories
nomen.info: Group the edges of a mesh into various mutually exclusive categories.

outputs.name: Welded Edges
outputs.info: Edges with two adjacent facets and no stacked vertices.

outputs.name: Unwelded Edges
outputs.info: Edges with two adjacent facets and stacked vertices at one or both ends.

outputs.name: Naked Edges
outputs.info: Edges with only a single adjacent facet.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Edges
outputs.info: Edges with three or more adjacent facets.

nomen.name: Mesh Edge Map
nomen.info: Create a map from all mesh edges to all facet and vertex indices.

outputs.name: Facets
outputs.info: For each edge, the list of adjacent facet indices.

outputs.name: Start Vertices
outputs.info: For each edge, the index of the vertex at its start.

outputs.name: End Vertices
outputs.info: For each edge, the index of the vertex at its end.

nomen.name: Mesh Facet
nomen.info: Extract the corner indices and normal direction of a specific mesh facet.

inputs.name: Facet Index
inputs.info: Index of mesh facet to extract.

outputs.name: Facet Normal
outputs.info: Normal direction of facet, if available.

nomen.name: Facet Categories
nomen.info: Group the facets of a mesh into various mutually exclusive categories.

outputs.name: Welded Facets
outputs.info: Facets with no naked, unwelded or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Welded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of facets with no naked, unwelded or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Unwelded Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one unwelded edge, but no naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Unwelded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of facets with at least one unwelded edge, but no naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one naked edge and no non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Indices
outputs.info: Indices of facets with at least one naked edge and no non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one non-manifold edge.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Indices
outputs.info: Indices of facets with at least one non-manifold edge.

nomen.name: Facet Categories
nomen.info: Group the facets of a mesh into into various mutually exclusive categories.

outputs.name: Welded Facets
outputs.info: Facets with no naked, unwelded or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Unwelded Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one unwelded edge, but no naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one naked edge and no non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Facets
outputs.info: Facets with at least one non-manifold edge.

nomen.name: Mesh Facet Map
nomen.info: Create a map from all mesh facets to all vertex and edge indices.

outputs.name: Vertices
outputs.info: For each facet, the list of all its vertex indices.

outputs.name: Edges
outputs.info: For each facet, the list of all its edge indices.

nomen.name: Vertex Neighbourhood
nomen.info: Create small patches covering the surrounding neighbourhood of every vertex in a mesh.

inputs.name: With Edges
inputs.info: Include edge points in the neigbourhood.

inputs.name: Edge Points
inputs.info: Location of neighbourhood boundary points on edges.

nomen.name: Mesh Vertex
nomen.info: Extract the location, normal direction, and colour of a specific mesh vertex.

inputs.name: Vertex Index
inputs.info: Index of mesh vertex to extract.

outputs.name: Vertex Normal
outputs.info: Normal direction of vertex, if available.

nomen.name: Vertex Categories
nomen.info: Group the vertices of a mesh into various mutually exclusive categories.

outputs.name: Welded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of vertices with only welded edges.

outputs.name: Unwelded Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one unwelded edge, and without any naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Unwelded Indices
outputs.info: Indices of vertices with at least one unwelded edge, and without any naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one naked edge, and without any non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Indices
outputs.info: Indices of vertices with at least one naked edge, and without any non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one non-manifold edge.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Indices
outputs.info: Indices of vertices with at least one non-manifold edge.

nomen.name: Vertex Categories
nomen.info: Group the vertices of a mesh into various mutually exclusive categories.

inputs.name: Topological Analysis
inputs.info: Only consider vertices with distinct locations.

outputs.name: Unwelded Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one unwelded edge, and without any naked or non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Naked Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one naked edge, and without any non-manifold edges.

outputs.name: Non-manifold Vertices
outputs.info: Vertices with at least one non-manifold edge.

nomen.name: Mesh Vertex Map
nomen.info: Create a map from all mesh vertices to all edges and facets.

inputs.name: Topological Analysis
inputs.info: Include mappings to edges and facets on the other side of an unwelded edge.

outputs.name: Edges
outputs.info: For each vertex, the list of all edges that terminate there.

outputs.name: Facets
outputs.info: For each vertex, the list of all facets that contain it.

nomen.name: Vertex Edges
nomen.info: Find all the edge indices emanating from a specified vertex.

inputs.name: Vertex Index
inputs.info: Index of vertex for edge search.

outputs.name: Direct Edges
outputs.info: Indices of all edges whose adjacent facets directly rely on the specified vertex.

outputs.name: Indirect Edges
outputs.info: Indices of all edges whose end points are coincident with the specified vertex.

nomen.name: Vertex Facets
nomen.info: Find all the facet indices that rely upon a given vertex.

outputs.name: Direct Facets
outputs.info: Indices of all facets which directly rely on the specified vertex.

outputs.name: Indirect Facets
outputs.info: Indices of all facets which rely on a vertex coincident with the specified vertex.

nomen.name: Vertex Neighbours
nomen.info: Extract the neighbouring vertices of a mesh vertex.

inputs.name: Jump Creases
inputs.info: If true, topological rather than geometrical connectivity is resolved.

outputs.name: Immediate Neighbours
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices directly connected by an edge to the specified index.

outputs.name: Indirect Neighbours
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices indirectly connected to the specified vertex, i.e. antipodal vertices on quads.

nomen.name: Vertex Neighbours
nomen.info: Extract the neighbouring vertices of a mesh vertex.

outputs.name: Immediate Neighbours
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices directly connected to the specified index.

outputs.name: Indirect Neighbours
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices indirectly connected to the specified vertex, i.e. by first crossing an unwelded edge.

nomen.name: Vertex Roommates
nomen.info: Extract the indices of all vertices coincident with the given vertex.

outputs.name: Roommate Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all vertices coincident with the given vertex.

outputs.name: Roommate Count
outputs.info: Number of coincident vertices. Zero means the vertex is fully welded, one or higher indicates the vertex is on an unwelded edge.

nomen.name: Dissect Mesh
nomen.info: Dissect a mesh into its component parts.

nomen.name: Evaluate Mesh
nomen.info: Evaluate a mesh at the given locus.

nomen.name: Mesh Closedness
nomen.info: Determine whether a mesh is closed and what its orientation is.

outputs.name: Closed
outputs.info: True if the mesh is closed. All edges in a closed mesh have exactly two facets on each side.

outputs.name: Outward Orientation
outputs.info: True if the mesh is oriented outwards.

nomen.name: Mesh Closest Point
nomen.info: Find the point on a mesh closest to a given point.

nomen.name: Mesh Edge Lines
nomen.info: Extract the line shapes and given details of all the edges in a mesh.

outputs.name: Welded State
outputs.info: True if this edge is welded.

outputs.name: Facet Valence
outputs.info: Number of facets adjacent to this edge.

nomen.name: Mesh Facet Boundaries
nomen.info: Extract the facet boundaries, areas and aspect ratios of a mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh Facets
nomen.info: Extract the corner indices, normals and descriptions of all mesh facets.

outputs.name: Descriptions
outputs.info: Facet description, with various properties shown as text tags separated by commas.

nomen.name: Mesh-Self
nomen.info: Find the areas where a mesh intersects itself.

outputs.name: Perforations
outputs.info: Polylines tracking where the mesh perforates itself.

outputs.name: Overlaps
outputs.info: Polylines surrounding the self overlapping regions.

nomen.name: Mesh Shadows
nomen.info: Find the shadow outlines of a mesh as cast onto a plane.

nomen.name: Mesh Thickness
nomen.info: Find the mesh vertices where the distance to the opposite side is within a given range.

inputs.name: Range
inputs.info: Thickness range for outputs. Measurements outside of this range will be omitted.

inputs.name: Sharpness Angle
inputs.info: Angle at which a mesh feature is considered 'sharp'.

outputs.name: Vertices
outputs.info: Vertex indices where the mesh thickness is within the given range.

outputs.name: Points
outputs.info: Points where the mesh thickness is within the given range.

nomen.name: Mesh Vertices
nomen.info: Extract the vertices, normals and per-vertex colours of a mesh.

nomen.name: Nearest Mesh Edge
nomen.info: Find the mesh edge closest to a search locus.

nomen.name: Nearest Mesh Facet
nomen.info: Find the mesh facet closest to a given search locus.

nomen.name: Nearest Mesh Vertex
nomen.info: Find the mesh vertex closest to a given search locus.

nomen.name: Construct Colour Mesh
nomen.info: Construct a mesh out of vertices, facets and per-vertex colours.

nomen.name: Construct Mesh
nomen.info: Construct a mesh out of vertices and facets.

nomen.name: Convex Facets
nomen.info: Create the convex hull of a list of points, and output the hull's facet outlines as polylines.

inputs.name: Points
inputs.info: Points to include in the hull.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of the input points on each facet outline.

nomen.name: Convex Hull 3D
nomen.info: Create a three-dimensional convex hull for a set of points.

inputs.name: Points
inputs.info: Points to include in the hull.

inputs.name: Weld
inputs.info: Whether the hull mesh shares vertices between facets (welded) or keeps each facet's vertices separate (unwelded).

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of the input points used as vertices on the hull.

nomen.name: Indexed Constraint
nomen.info: Create a tesselation constraint which connects indexed points.

nomen.name: Mesh From Boundary
nomen.info: Create a mesh out of a planar polyline boundary.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.info: Planar, closed polyline boundary for the mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh From Surface
nomen.info: Create a triangular mesh from a surface.

inputs.name: Grid min count
inputs.info: The minimal grid count in the initial quad mesh

inputs.name: Grid max count
inputs.info: The maximal grid count in the initial quad mesh

outputs.name: Meshes
outputs.info: The mesh or meshes obtained by the default Rhino mesher.

nomen.name: Mesh From Constraints
nomen.info: Construct a constrained tesselation out of points and optional boundaries.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional override for tesselation plane. If omitted, the best fit plane is used.

inputs.name: Balance
inputs.info: Insert additional vertices to balance the output mesh.

inputs.name: Constraints
inputs.info: Optional tesselation constraints such as boundaries, holes and hard edges. These must be created using dedicated components.

nomen.name: Mesh From Edges
nomen.info: Create a mesh out of a collection of potential edge lines.

inputs.name: Valence
inputs.info: Allowed facet valence, i.e. the maximum number of allowed edges per facet.

outputs.name: Mesh
outputs.info: Mesh constructed from edges which were part of closed loops.

outputs.name: Shortfall
outputs.info: Number of lines, which did not become mesh edges.

nomen.name: Mesh From Grid
nomen.info: Create a mesh out of multiple rows of points.

inputs.name: Points
inputs.info: Sequential rows of points. When the number of points in a subsequent row changes, a new grid is started. When the penultimate integer in the tree path of a point list changes, this also signals the start of a new grid.

inputs.name: Close U
inputs.info: Open or close the mesh in the U direction.

inputs.name: Close V
inputs.info: Open or close the mesh in the V direction.

outputs.name: Paths
outputs.info: Ranges of paths that were used to create each mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh From Points
nomen.info: Create a mesh by tesselating a collection of points, using a Delaunay triangulation algorithm.

inputs.name: Space
inputs.info: Optional underlying space in which to perform tesselation.

outputs.name: Mesh
outputs.info: Delaunay-compliant mesh with vertices at all non-coincident points.

nomen.name: Mesh Patch
nomen.info: Create a mesh out of boundary and hole curves, with optional points.

inputs.name: Curves
inputs.info: Boundary curves for the patch. Curves inside other curves will automatically be treated as hole boundaries.

inputs.name: Edges
inputs.info: Optional interior edge constraints for patch.

outputs.name: Mesh
outputs.info: Mesh coincident with boundaries, points and edges.

nomen.name: Mesh Pipe
nomen.info: Create a tube-shaped mesh with a specified number of facets.

inputs.name: Segments
inputs.info: Number of facets around the pipe.

inputs.name: Accuracy
inputs.info: Value regulating the number of facets along the curve (0 = fewest facets, 1 = most facets) .

inputs.name: Cap Type
inputs.info: Type of cap at each discontinuity along the curve.

nomen.name: Mesh From UV
nomen.info: Create a discrete mesh approximation of a surface.

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.info: Optional absolute tolerance to use during approximation.

inputs.name: Planes
inputs.info: If true, nice planar surfaces will result in the simplest possible meshes.

inputs.name: Jagged
inputs.info: If true, meshes belonging to different surface faces will not be stitched together along edges.

inputs.name: Precise
inputs.info: If true, the mesh vertices will use high precision coordinates.

inputs.name: Repair
inputs.info: If true, attempts will be made to close the mesh if it isn't yet but should be.

inputs.name: Minimum Edge
inputs.info: Optional minimum allowed edge length. This places a lower limit on the subdivision density.

inputs.name: Maximum Edge
inputs.info: Optional maximum allowed edge length. This places limits on the allowed size of long mesh edges.

inputs.name: Refine Grid
inputs.info: If true, the initial sampling grid can be refined to better fit local conditions.

inputs.name: Minimum Grid
inputs.info: Optional minimum number of quads in the initial sampling grid.

inputs.name: Maximum Grid
inputs.info: Optional maximum number of quads in the initial sampling grid.

inputs.name: Grid Aspect
inputs.info: Optional limits on the aspect ratio of quads in the initial sampling grid.

nomen.name: Polyline Constraint
nomen.info: Create a tesselation constraint which connects point coordinates.

nomen.name: Subdivide Mesh
nomen.info: Apply a subdivision scheme to an existing mesh.

inputs.name: Steps
inputs.info: Number of subdivision steps. Each additional step approximately quadruples the number of facets in a mesh.

inputs.name: Retain Creases
inputs.info: Retain the unwelded creases in the input mesh.

inputs.name: Retain Corners
inputs.info: Specify the angle, above which convex corners of the input mesh boundary will be retained.

nomen.name: Voronoi Cells
nomen.info: Construct the 2D voronoi cell boundaries for a collection of points.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional plane override. If omitted, the best fit plane is used.

inputs.name: Extend
inputs.info: Extension length of cell boundaries going off to infinity.

nomen.name: Voronoi Edges
nomen.info: Construct the 2D voronoi edges for a collection of points.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Optional plane override. If omitted, the best fit plane is used.

inputs.name: Extend
inputs.info: Extension length of voronoi edges going off to infinity.

nomen.name: Voronoi On Surface
nomen.info: Construct a Voronoi tesselation within the UV space of a surface.

nomen.name: Weighted Voronoi
nomen.info: Construct the 2D Voronoi diagram of points with additive and multiplicative weights.

inputs.name: Points
inputs.info: Site points, in the XY plane.

inputs.name: Multiplicative
inputs.info: Optional multiplicative weight per point (positive). If omitted, all weights are 1.

inputs.name: Additive
inputs.info: Optional additive weight per point. If omitted, all weights are 0.

inputs.name: Blend
inputs.info: 0 for a purely additive diagram, 1 for a purely multiplicative one.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.info: Optional clipping rectangle. If omitted, the points' bounding box grown by a quarter is used.

outputs.name: Left
outputs.info: Index of the site on the left of each edge, -1 for the outside.

outputs.name: Right
outputs.info: Index of the site on the right of each edge, -1 for the outside.

outputs.name: Cells
outputs.info: Closed cell boundaries. A cell with holes gives several loops, holes run clockwise.

outputs.name: Cell Index
outputs.info: Index of the site of each cell loop.

nomen.name: Align Vertices
nomen.info: Snap together mesh vertices which are closer than a specified distance.

inputs.name: Mesh
inputs.info: Mesh or meshes whose vertices to align.

inputs.name: Distance
inputs.info: Distance within which to align vertices.

inputs.name: Naked Only
inputs.info: If true, only naked vertices will be aligned.

outputs.name: Mesh
outputs.info: Mesh or meshes with vertices aligned.

nomen.name: Blur Mesh
nomen.info: Blur the vertex colours of a mesh.

inputs.name: Fixed Vertices
inputs.info: Indices of vertices which should keep their colour fixed during blurring.

inputs.name: Iterations
inputs.info: Number of blurring iterations to perform.

nomen.name: Clothe Naked Edges
nomen.info: Attempt to clothe all naked edges in a mesh either by slightly moving nearby vertices together, or by splitting edges located near naked vertices.

inputs.name: Mesh
inputs.info: Mesh with naked edges to fix.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.info: True if naked edges were fixed.

nomen.name: Collapse Facets
nomen.info: Collapse mesh facets whose indices are included in a given list.

nomen.name: Collapse Indicated Facets
nomen.info: Collapse facets in a mesh using a list of booleans.

inputs.name: Map
inputs.info: Boolean list indicating whether to collapse individual facets.

nomen.name: Collapse Particular Facets
nomen.info: Collapse mesh facets whose properties exceed given threshold values.

inputs.name: Area
inputs.info: Optional area limit. Facets with areas smaller than this limit will be collapsed.

inputs.name: Aspect
inputs.info: Optional aspect ratio limit. Facets with aspect ratios less than this limit will be collapsed.

inputs.name: Edge Length
inputs.info: Optional edge length limit. Facets with edges whose lengths are smaller than this limit will be collapsed.

nomen.name: Cull Facets
nomen.info: Remove mesh facets indicated by a boolean pattern.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Culling pattern. Faces paired up with the value `false` in the pattern are retained, while those paired up with the value `true` are culled.

nomen.name: Cull Vertices
nomen.info: Remove mesh vertices indicated by a boolean pattern.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Culling pattern. Vertices paired up with the value `false` in the pattern are retained, while those paired up with the value `true` are culled.

inputs.name: Shrink
inputs.info: Shrink affected quads to triangles if possible.

nomen.name: Delete Facets
nomen.info: Delete mesh facets whose indices are included in a given list.

nomen.name: Delete Particular Facets
nomen.info: Delete all mesh facets whose properties exceed various threshold values.

inputs.name: Area
inputs.info: Optional area limit. Facets with areas smaller than this will be deleted.

inputs.name: Aspect
inputs.info: Optional aspect ratio limit. Facets with aspect ratios less than this will be deleted.

inputs.name: Edge Length
inputs.info: Optional edge length limit. Facets whose shortest edge is smaller than this value will be deleted.

nomen.name: Delete Vertices
nomen.info: Delete mesh vertices whose indices are included in a given list.

nomen.name: Fill Mesh Holes
nomen.info: Attempt to patch all holes in a mesh by triangulating loops of naked edges.

outputs.name: Mesh
outputs.info: Mesh with, hopefully fewer, ideally no holes.

nomen.name: Flip Mesh
nomen.info: Flip the normal directions of a mesh.

inputs.name: Vertex Normals
inputs.info: If true, flip the vertex normal directions.

inputs.name: Facet Normals
inputs.info: If true, flip the facet normal directions.

inputs.name: Facet Orientations
inputs.info: If true, reverse the facet orientations.

inputs.name: Ngon Directions
inputs.info: If true, reverse the boundary directions of n-gons.

nomen.name: Join Meshes
nomen.info: Join several meshes into a single mesh.

inputs.name: Merge Vertices
inputs.info: Merge coincident vertices in the joined mesh.

inputs.name: Match Edges
inputs.info: Match edges in the joined mesh.

nomen.name: Match Mesh Edges
nomen.info: Move the vertices and split the edges of a mesh until adjacent naked edges become coincident.

inputs.name: Mesh
inputs.info: Mesh with naked edges to match.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.info: True if any edges were matched.

nomen.name: Merge Coplanar Facets
nomen.info: Merge contiguous coplanar mesh facets into single n-gons.

inputs.name: Allow Holes
inputs.info: Allow the creation of n-gons with holes.

nomen.name: Mesh Split Plane
nomen.info: Split a mesh with an infinite plane.

outputs.name: Above
outputs.info: Mesh fragments on the positive side of the plane.

outputs.name: Below
outputs.info: Mesh fragments on the negative side of the plane.

outputs.name: Sections
outputs.info: Cut polylines where the plane intersects the mesh.

nomen.name: Move Mesh Vertices
nomen.info: Move vertices of an existing mesh using per-vertex motion vectors.

inputs.name: Recompute Normals
inputs.info: Recompute the mesh normals to reflect the change in shape.

nomen.name: Offset Mesh
nomen.info: Offset the vertices of a mesh along their normal directions.

inputs.name: Offset Distance
inputs.info: Offset distance. Positive values indicate the offset is in the direction of the normal.

inputs.name: Solidify
inputs.info: Specifies whether the offset mesh and the original mesh are stitched together along their naked edges.

inputs.name: Average Normals
inputs.info: Specifies whether to average the normals along creases prior to offsetting.

nomen.name: Pull Mesh Vertices
nomen.info: Pull mesh vertices onto nearby shapes.

inputs.name: Falloff
inputs.info: Distance threshold for the pulling operation as a number, or a falloff function based on distance.

inputs.name: Vertex Filter
inputs.info: Types of vertices to be included.

nomen.name: Quad Remesh
nomen.info: Create a new quad mesh based on an existing shape.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Base shape. Must be either a mesh or a surface.

inputs.name: Target Count
inputs.info: Optional target quad count. When unset, the 'Target Length' will be used instead.

inputs.name: Target Length
inputs.info: Optional target edge length. When unset, the 'Target Count' will be used instead.

inputs.name: Adaptive Size
inputs.info: A number between zero and one hundred controlling how quad sizes change depending on curvature.

inputs.name: Adaptive Count
inputs.info: If true, allows high curvature areas to affect the target quad count.

inputs.name: Maintain Edges
inputs.info: Specifies how surface edges are maintained during remeshing.

inputs.name: Maintain Creases
inputs.info: If true, sharp creases in the underlying surface are maintained.

inputs.name: Guide Curves
inputs.info: Optional guide curves for local remeshing directions.

inputs.name: Symmetry
inputs.info: Symmetry axis to apply during remeshing.

nomen.name: Quad Remesh
nomen.info: Create a new quad mesh based on an existing shape.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Base shape. Must be either a mesh or a surface.

inputs.name: Options
inputs.info: Quad remeshing options. These can be created using a dedicated component.

inputs.name: Guides
inputs.info: Optional guide curves for local remeshing directions.

nomen.name: Quad Remesh Options
nomen.info: Create settings used for quad remesh operations.

inputs.name: Target Count
inputs.info: Target quad count. When unset, the 'Target Length' will be used instead.

inputs.name: Target Length
inputs.info: Target edge length. When unset, the 'Target Count' will be used instead.

inputs.name: Adaptive Size
inputs.info: A number between zero and one hundred controlling how quad sizes change depending on curvature.

inputs.name: Adaptive Count
inputs.info: Specifies whether high curvature areas are allowed to affect the target quad count.

inputs.name: Maintain Edges
inputs.info: Specifies how surface edges are maintained during remeshing.

inputs.name: Maintain Creases
inputs.info: Specifies whether sharp creases are maintained.

inputs.name: Symmetry
inputs.info: Symmetry axis to apply during remeshing.

nomen.name: Rebuild Mesh Normals
nomen.info: Reconstruct all vertex and facet normals based on the shape of the mesh.

nomen.name: Reduce Mesh
nomen.info: Reduce the facet count of a mesh by merging smaller facets into larger ones.

inputs.name: Allow Distortion
inputs.info: Specifies whether the mesh shape may be distorted.

nomen.name: Remesh
nomen.info: Create a new mesh based on the shape of an existing one.

inputs.name: Target Count
inputs.info: Target facet count. High curvature areas in the mesh may cause the remesher to veer away from the target.

nomen.name: Retopologise Facets
nomen.info: Triangulate or quadrangulate mesh facets.

nomen.name: Mesh Colours
nomen.info: Set the vertex colours of an existing mesh.

nomen.name: Mesh Colours From Numbers
nomen.info: Colour the vertices of a mesh by evaluating a given gradient.

inputs.name: Numbers
inputs.info: List of numbers encoding the value of each vertex.

inputs.name: Scaling Method
inputs.info: Scaling method for stretching the gradient to the number distribution.

nomen.name: Mesh Colours From Field
nomen.info: Set the vertex colours of an existing mesh, using a scalar field and a gradient.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.info: Scalar field for computing gradient parameters per vertex.

nomen.name: Set Mesh Normals
nomen.info: Set the vertex normals of an existing mesh.

nomen.name: Set Mesh Vertices
nomen.info: Change the vertex locations of an existing mesh.

inputs.name: Recompute Normals
inputs.info: Recompute the normals of the mesh to reflect the change in shape.

nomen.name: Shrinkwrap
nomen.info: Shrinkwrap geometry with a mesh.

inputs.name: Offset
inputs.info: Inwards or outwards offset distance of the wrap.

inputs.name: Smoothing
inputs.info: Number of smoothing iterations to perform.

inputs.name: Optimisation
inputs.info: Polygon optimisation factor between 0 and 1. Lower values give better feature preservation at the cost of a higher facet count.

inputs.name: Fill Holes
inputs.info: If true, holes in the input are filled before wrapping.

inputs.name: Edge Length
inputs.info: Optional target edge length for wrapping mesh. If omitted, a fraction of the bounding box is used.

inputs.name: Meshing Density
inputs.info: Meshing density factor between 0 and 1 to use when meshing input surfaces.

nomen.name: Smooth Mesh
nomen.info: Smooth an existing mesh by moving vertices towards the averaged out locations of their neighbours.

inputs.name: Strength
inputs.info: Smoothing strength as a factor between zero for no smoothing, and one for full smoothing.

inputs.name: Limit
inputs.info: Optional limit for how far vertices may move.

inputs.name: Clamp Naked Edges
inputs.info: Clamp vertices on naked edges in place.

inputs.name: Clamp Creases
inputs.info: Clamp vertices on unwelded edges in place.

inputs.name: Iterations
inputs.info: Number of times to apply the smoothing process.

nomen.name: Split Disjoint Meshes
nomen.info: Split a single mesh into its disjoint component parts.

nomen.name: Split Unwelded Meshes
nomen.info: Split a single mesh into its unwelded component parts.

nomen.name: Tri Remesh
nomen.info: Create a triangular mesh with improved triangle quality from an input geometry.

inputs.name: Start Geometry
inputs.info: The starting geometry to remesh. Can be a mesh or a surface.

inputs.name: Sharp
inputs.info: If true, sharp creases and corners will be preserved.

inputs.name: Feature Curves
inputs.info: Optional curves to preserve as edges.

inputs.name: Feature Points
inputs.info: Optional points to preserve as vertices.

inputs.name: Target Edge Length
inputs.info: Optional target edge length. If omitted, 1/30th of the diagonal of the shape bounding box is used.

inputs.name: Iterations
inputs.info: Maximum number of iterations to run the remeshing process if not converged.

outputs.name: Feature Edges
outputs.info: Edge lines preserved in the remeshing process.

nomen.name: Unify Mesh Normals
nomen.info: Fix mesh normal inconsistencies caused by facet winding orientations.

inputs.name: Unify Facets
inputs.info: Unify facet normals and winding orientations based on the surrounding facets.

inputs.name: Unify Vertices
inputs.info: Unify vertex normals based on the surrounding facet normals.

nomen.name: Unweld Mesh
nomen.info: Unweld all mesh edges whose adjacent facets form an angle sharper than a given threshold.

inputs.name: Unwelding Angle
inputs.info: Unweld angle. All edges whose adjacent facets form an angle sharper than this threshold will be unwelded.

nomen.name: Warp Mesh Normals
nomen.info: Assign vertex normals from a vector field to an existing mesh.

nomen.name: Warp Mesh Vertices
nomen.info: Move the vertices of an existing mesh using a vector field.

inputs.name: Recompute Normals
inputs.info: Specifies whether to recompute the normals of the mesh to reflect the change in shape.

nomen.name: Weld Mesh
nomen.info: Weld all edges in a mesh whose adjacent facets form an angle exceeding a given threshold.

inputs.name: Welding Angle
inputs.info: All edges whose adjacent facets form an angle larger than this threshold will be welded.
